product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)
provenance_note: every fact here is read from the registry that owns it and re-derivable by build.py; the fixture record is SCRIPTED and labelled as not a learner

proves: the record has not changed since it was exported: its SHA-256 digest recomputes over the canonical form
every lesson, step, hall, seat, scenario, station and district it names exists in this bundle at the stated pack version
every step marked done whose kind writes a training episode carries that episode as evidence
no lesson is marked complete with a step still undone, and none ahead of its ladder prerequisite
does_not_prove: who the learner is: identity.claimed is typed by the person, attested by this device only, and nothing checks it - unless a wallet signed, in which case it is the identity of a key, not of a person; a stolen key signs just as well
anything on any blockchain: a wallet signature is computed in the browser and carried in the file; nothing is written to any chain, nothing is anchored, and no one can look it up
that the device was honest: a record can be written by hand and will verify if it is internally consistent

that a walk or placard episode means more than it says: it records that a device saw the walker's position inside a room, or a placard panel left open for its dwell with the walker in that room - not that anyone read, understood or took on what the placard requires, and not that the room exists outside this bundle
that a self-reported step happened at all (no step kind is self-reported today; the rule stays so one that is added cannot carry evidence it does not have)

that a station or crib episode means more than it says: it records that a device saw a correct pick on a station quiz, or a crib check finished with every pick right - not that the checklist was read, that the pick was not found by trying every option, that anything was learned or that the learner can name the tools. The marks in tc-progress (the record's `stations` and `tools` blocks) are device-local marks the halls keep for their own HUD; they feed no step

that every episode-backed step is equally strong evidence: of the step kinds, sim, station and crib are graded by the page (strong), advisor, crew and walkaround record a deliberate act with nothing graded (act), and walk and placard record only presence in a room (presence). A lesson counted as fully verifiable by episode may hold presence and act steps alone; the summary a verifier prints splits the steps by strength, and none of this changes what verifies
that the seat was passed under supervision, or that any score means anything outside this bundle
any accreditation, ticket, licence or credential; no hall, employer or authority has signed anything
any duration of training, and no price is claimed
honesty.digest: a digest proves integrity since export, not identity
honesty.signature: null unless a wallet signed: this bundle has no key of its own and no server, so an unsigned record is attested by this device only. A signed record carries an EIP-191 personal_sign signature by the connected wallet over this record's digest; it proves that the holder of that key signed this digest at export - the identity of a key, not of a person. A signature that does not recover to the address it claims, or that signs any other message, is refused as a forgery. Nothing is written to any chain and nothing is anchored.

product.proves: which product wrote it; nothing about the learner

pack_version.proves: which registries the ids resolve against

exported_at.proves: nothing: a device clock is not attested

identity.is: {claimed: string|null, attested_by: "this device only" | "wallet signature over the digest", signature: null | {scheme: "eip191-personal_sign", address, message, sig}}
identity.proves: unsigned: nothing about who the learner is; claimed is typed, not checked. Signed: that the holder of the key for `address` signed this digest at export - a key, not a person; see registry#signature

lessons.is: one entry per lesson the export covers: lesson id, hall, complete, steps[]
lessons.proves: per step: done and its evidence per the evidence rule of its kind

sims.proves: the page marked the seat passed; the score has no registry threshold

tools.proves: the crib check was graded passed on this device

stations.proves: a station was taken at its bench on this device

honesty.is: the proves / does_not_prove lists of this registry, carried in the record
honesty.proves: that the record says of itself what this registry says of it

digest.over: canonical JSON of every top-level field except digest, with identity.signature forced to null: keys sorted recursively, no whitespace, UTF-8
digest.excludes_signature_why: the signature is a signature OVER the digest, made after it; a digest that covered it would be circular. Every other byte of identity (claimed, attested_by) is covered.
digest.numbers: exporters write integers for score and attempts so Python and JavaScript canonicalise alike

digest.excludes_signature_why: the signature is a signature OVER the digest, made after it; a digest that covered it would be circular. Every other byte of identity (claimed, attested_by) is covered.

signature.null_means: unsigned: this device only. Then identity.attested_by must be exactly "this device only" and identity.claimed is whatever was typed.

object_shape.address: 0x + 40 hex, the signer the wallet reported

message.statement: I am naming this Ethereum account as the owner of the Trade Craft Academy training record kept in this browser. This signature does not log me in, does not reach any server, and protects nothing: this bundle has no backend.
message.statement_from: auth/registry/auth.json#siwe.statement - the line auth/ already puts in front of the human
message.why_fixed: the verifier rebuilds this message from THIS record's digest.hex and exported_at and requires equality, so a signature over any other text - another record, another export, a friendly sentence - is refused by name

signature.when_signed: identity.attested_by must be exactly "wallet signature over the digest", identity.claimed must equal signature.address, and the address recovered from (message, sig) must equal both - compared as lowercase hex, so EIP-55 casing differences are not a mismatch
signature.order: digest first: a tampered digest under a valid signature fails `digest` (and the signature no longer matches the rebuilt message, so identity.signature is listed after it); a tampered message or sig with an intact digest fails `identity.signature` alone
signature.recovery: auth/recover.mjs, which lifts the AUTH-CORE region of web/trade_craft_signin.html - the sign-in page's own keccak-256, secp256k1 recovery and EIP-55 derivation, the code auth/test.mjs holds against node's sha3-256, node's secp256k1 and the published addresses of keys 1, 2 and 3. No second keccak and no second curve exist in this pack.
signature.where_the_wallet_comes_from: the progress page reads the identity the sign-in page stored under tc-identity; only a record whose method is siwe-ethereum carries an address, and only then is signing offered. No wallet, no signature: the record stays unsigned and says so. A signature is never fabricated by the page.
signature.proves: that the holder of the private key for signature.address signed this record's digest at export. The identity of a key, not of a person.
does_not_prove: who the person is: a key is held, lent, shared and stolen
anything about any chain: nothing is written to any chain, nothing is anchored, no transaction exists
that the record is true: the digest covers what the device exported, and the device can be edited
any accreditation: no hall, employer or authority has signed anything

evidence_classes.episode-backed: the step kind records a training episode; only this class is called evidence-backed
evidence_classes.device-mark: no step kind today (station and crib were device marks until wave 21 and now write episodes): a mark in the device-local progress record, not a recorded episode. The class and the verifier branch for it stay, inert, so a kind added later that leaves only a mark cannot be called evidence-backed
evidence_classes.self-reported: no step kind today (walk and placard recorded nothing before wave 20 and now write episodes): done would be the learner's word. The class and its rules stay, so a kind added with no record cannot carry evidence it does not have

levels.strong: the page grades the learner's answer or run against a key or rubric and writes the episode only on a pass (sim, station, crib). Still a device event: it does not say the learner was alone, unaided or did not retry
levels.act: a deliberate act of the learner is recorded and nothing is graded: a fixed question asked, a point marked (advisor, crew, walkaround). It says the act happened, not that the answer was understood or the point true
levels.presence: only that a device saw the walker inside a room, or a placard panel left open for its dwell with the walker in that room (walk, placard). The learner need not have done anything else

sim.why: a scored run: the seat's rubric rows are graded by the sim and the episode records the outcome (passed, rows); the step is held to the seat and scenario it names

station.why: a graded answer: the episode is written only when the station quiz is answered with the correct option, checked by the page against the station's own key. Wrong picks tried first are not recorded, so a quiz can be passed by trying every option

crib.why: a graded check: the episode is written only when the district crib check is finished with every pick right (picks at least the declared number). A failed run records nothing, so retries before the pass are invisible

advisor.why: one fixed topic asked of the advisor and answered from a record or the advisor registry; nothing about the learner is graded - it records the question, not that the answer was understood

crew.why: one fixed topic asked of one crew role while the seat ran; nothing is graded - it records the question, not that the answer was understood

walkaround.why: one point marked by the learner; the sims registry itself says a point is not a score and not a gate, so this is a tick, not a graded outcome

walk.why: the walker's position entered the rectangle of one room; no path, no dwell, no act

placard.why: a placard panel stayed open for its dwell while the walker stood in the room; it does not say the placard was read

evidence_strength.reported_only: strength is reported next to every total and read by no verifier rule: it changes what a summary says, never what passes. An episode-backed step is still only a device event; the self-reported / device-mark classes stay the guard they were
evidence_strength.headline: a lesson counted as fully verifiable by episode may rest on presence and act steps alone; lessons_with_a_strong_step says how many hold at least one graded step, lessons_every_step_strong how many hold nothing else

signed.why_not_on_disk: python3's stdlib has no keccak-256 and no secp256k1, and writing a second one here would be a second truth; the key is a throwaway generated by node:crypto (generateKeyPairSync secp256k1) so it differs per run, and a build must be deterministic. The signing routine lives ONLY in the test; the verifier only recovers.
signed.good: the fixture re-attested "wallet signature over the digest" with claimed = the throwaway address, digest restamped, then signed over the structured message: verifies on every rule and the verifier prints the recovered address

mutants.signed-digest-tampered: digest, listed first; identity.signature follows because the signed message names the old digest
